title: Fun-Money vs Essentials Ratio
dataSources: Micro-spend transactions (`microspend:txn`), no-spend days (`nospend:day`), price-per-use items (`priceperuse:item`), cash-back rewards (`cashback:reward`).
app: Bank-transaction exports categorised for micro-spending, no-spend-day trackers, price-per-use logs, and cash-back / rewards feeds — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=microspend:txn
| eval bucket=if(category IN ("rent","utilities","groceries","transport"),"essential","discretionary")
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(amount) as spend by bucket _time
| sort - _time
description: Splits your monthly spending into essentials versus discretionary fun money, a quick check on balance.
value: The essentials-to-fun ratio is a fast health check on a budget without needing to itemise every line.
implementation: Bucket transactions in `index=personal`; schedule monthly and compare essential versus discretionary spend.
visualization: Stacked column chart of essential versus discretionary spend.
grandmaExplanation: It splits your spending into needs versus fun, a quick check that your budget is in balance.
